vb_textbox.text: The methodology I settled on was to select the gnome with the biggest hat. I had tried several different methods to try and determine a method but the allocation seemed to be random. I had no success with trying to match the colours of the gnomes to the mushroom basket. I also had no success trying to remember the previous high value gnomes and hats. I tried to spot a pattern between left and right variations but in the end settled with whoever had the biggest hat. It seemed to be as successful as any other method for points scoring.
